title: Plug-ins
error: Something went wrong with that plug-in.

manage.title: Plug-ins
manage.description: Plug-ins add something the whole community shares. Only the community's superadmin can add or remove them.
manage.removeBody: What it created moves to the trash, where it can still be restored. Every credential it held — the community's and each member's — is deleted, and the plug-in is told to stop using them.
manage.eraseHelp: The plug-in is asked to delete everything it holds about this community. If you add it again later, it starts afresh.
manage.unavailable: Not set up on this server
manage.autoUpdateHelp: New versions from the publisher are applied on their own. Turn this off to read each one first and update by hand.
manage.autoUpdateOff: Updates are now applied by hand.
manage.removeManagedNeutral: Charges for this plug-in are managed by your provider.

updates.declined: You declined version {{version}}. The plug-in stays on its current version.
updates.moved: A different version is now available. Review what it asks for.

install.title: Add {{name}}
install.description: This adds something for the whole community. You can rename it now or later.
install.name: Name
install.adminOnly: Ask your community's superadmin to add this plug-in.
install.unknownState: Could not check whether this plug-in is already added.
install.whereDescription: It shows its page, and reads and changes things, only in the initiatives you choose.
install.whereDescriptionNoPage: It reads and changes things only in the initiatives you choose.
install.callersDescription: These plug-ins in your community ask to use {{name}}. Each one you leave ticked can.
install.entitlementRequired: This plug-in has to be set up for your community before it can be added.
install.termFull: This deployment's plan has no seat free for {{name}}.
install.termFullAskAdmins: Ask your community's admins to request it.

connections.none: This plug-in asks for nothing to be set up.
connections.memberSet: A community admin has set this up.
connections.memberNotSet: A community admin still has to set this up.
connections.communityFlowExplainer: This one is granted at the vendor rather than typed. Connecting opens their install page, where you choose the account and what this plug-in may see.
connections.personalExplainer: This one signs you in as yourself, so each member connects their own account. Nobody else sees yours.
connections.connectOpened: Finish connecting in the tab that just opened.
connections.connectUnavailable: This plug-in isn't set up on this server yet, so there's nowhere to sign in.
connections.blocked: A community admin has stopped you connecting this.
connections.expired: This connection has run out. Connect again to keep using it.

installSettings.title: Settings
installSettings.description: What this plug-in reads in this community.
installSettings.unique: No other community on this server can use it. Use a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters and digits.

members.title: Members
members.noPersonal: This plug-in has nothing members connect to individually.
members.revokeAllBody: Every member's stored credential is deleted and the plug-in is told to stop using it. The plug-in stays installed and keeps its community settings. Members can connect again afterwards.

consent.title: What it has asked to do as you
consent.description: {{name}} asks for each purpose on its own. Allow only what you're happy for it to do in your name. You can change your answer at any time.
consent.askedReadWrite: Asked to read and make changes
consent.statusReadWrite: Can read and change as you
consent.allowReadWrite: Let it read and change things as me
consent.allowed: Saved. {{name}} can do this as you.
consent.declinedToast: Declined. {{name}} won't do this as you.
consent.withdrawnToast: {{name}} has stopped doing this as you.
consent.memberRevoked: The plug-in has stopped acting as that member.
consent.revokeAllTitle: Stop this plug-in acting as everyone?
consent.revokeAllBody: The plug-in stops making requests in any member's name at once. It stays installed and keeps its settings, and members can allow it again themselves.
consent.revokedAll: The plug-in has stopped acting as everyone.

settings.description: Set up how this plug-in connects.
settings.adminDescription: What the community owns for this plug-in. Only the superadmin sees this.

page.handoffFailed: Could not open this plug-in. Try again in a moment.
page.failed: This plug-in could not be opened
page.unavailable: {{name}} is not set up on this server
page.unavailableDescription: Whoever runs this server needs to connect this plug-in's service before it can be opened.
page.noSurface: {{name}} has no page of its own

placement.title: Where this plug-in works
placement.description: This plug-in shows its page, and reads and changes things, only in the initiatives you choose.
placement.descriptionNoPage: This plug-in reads and changes things only in the initiatives you choose.
placement.none: No initiatives chosen, so this plug-in reaches nothing inside initiatives.

roles.title: Who can open it here
roles.adminsAlways: Community admins can always open it.

connected.title: Connected
connected.body: Your account is linked. Initiative recorded it, so the plug-in's tiles will start answering for you.

refused.title: Not connected
refused.body: The other service did not complete the sign-in. Nothing changed here — try again from the plug-in's settings.

expired.title: That link has expired
expired.body: Connect links are short-lived. Start again from the plug-in's settings.

not_recorded.title: Nearly there
not_recorded.body: The other service signed you in, but Initiative did not record it. Connect again from the plug-in's settings — nothing was lost.

awaiting_approval.title: Waiting on an owner
awaiting_approval.body: The other service asked somebody who owns that organization to approve this plug-in. Nothing went wrong and nothing is set up yet — once they approve it, connect again from the plug-in's settings.

sign_in_required.title: Sign in to finish
sign_in_required.body: Finish connecting in the browser where you're signed in to Initiative, as the person who started it.

taken.title: Already connected elsewhere
taken.body: This organization is already connected to another community on this server, so nothing changed here. To connect it here, disconnect it there first, or remove the app from the organization at the other service and connect again.

scopes.title: What this plug-in can reach
scopes.description: Choose what this plug-in may read and change in this community.
scopes.error: Couldn't save what this plug-in can reach.

sharing.write: See and change who has access to what

initiatives.moderate: Act as a moderator in the initiatives it's placed in
